title: Dartmouth's Geisel School of Medicine Reportedly Used Canvas Activity Logs to Accuse Students of Cheating

behaviors.text: Dartmouth's Geisel School of Medicine reportedly used Canvas learning-management activity logs and an internal analysis process to investigate remote-exam cheating during the 2020–2021 academic year.

Seventeen [person] were charged after the school inferred that they accessed course materials during exams, but [person] and outside technical reviewers said automated Canvas activity may have been misread as intentional misconduct.
